questions.title: Bubble Sort Mechanism
questions.description: Bubble sort repeatedly:
questions.Option1: selects the smallest remaining element and places it at the front
questions.Option2: compares adjacent pairs and swaps them when out of order
questions.Option3: inserts each new element into a separate sorted list
questions.Option4: splits the array into halves and merges them

questions.title: Selection Sort Pass Action
questions.description: On each pass i, selection sort:
questions.Option2: shifts larger elements right to open a gap
questions.Option3: finds the minimum of the unsorted region and swaps it into position i
questions.Option4: partitions the array around a pivot

questions.title: Insertion Sort Mechanism
questions.description: Insertion sort builds the sorted region by:
questions.Option2: selecting the global maximum each pass
questions.Option4: taking the next element and shifting larger sorted elements right to insert it

questions.title: Early-Exit Bubble Best Case
questions.description: Bubble sort with an early-exit “no swap happened” flag on an already sorted array is:
questions.Option1: O(n), because one clean pass confirms the order

questions.Option3: a hash map of seen values

questions.title: Insertion Sort Best Case
questions.description: Insertion sort on an already sorted array takes:
